subject.title: chore(deps-dev): bump the development-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should ClawHub accept the Socket obfuscated-code warnings introduced by the Vite/react-email dependency updates, or should those bumps be removed or split before merge?
rationale: The alerts are supply-chain/security-boundary judgments rather than a mechanical code defect, and ClawSweeper cannot safely decide acceptable risk for new dependency code.

options.title: Triage alerts, then repair formatting
options.body: Review the linked Socket alerts and upstream packages, accept or ignore only if the risk is understood, then commit the required `src/styles.css` formatting output.

options.title: Narrow the dependency batch
options.body: Remove or split the alerted Vite/react-email-related updates so the lower-risk dependency bumps can proceed separately.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave the PR waiting until a maintainer with dependency security context can review the warnings and decide whether this batch is worth landing.

recommendation.title: Triage alerts, then repair formatting
recommendation.body: Review the linked Socket alerts and upstream packages, accept or ignore only if the risk is understood, then commit the required `src/styles.css` formatting output.
